description: GET /api/v3/pass?identifier={id} — LIST filter fallback for barcode backfill. Returns the same per-pass runtime artifact as the single-pass GET but at `data[].autoGeneratedId` (note: PLURAL — the LIST endpoint uses different field naming than single-pass GET which uses `generatedId`). For useAutoIdForValue=true templates, both fields carry the same real auto-generated barcode value. Used when the single-pass GET endpoint is unavailable (e.g., Passcreator changes the contract, network race, etc.).

backfillExtraction.rationale: Same real barcode value as single-pass GET's `generatedId`. When `barcodeValue` is a placeholder ('no value given' / 'no value specified' / 'no barcode' / ''), we fall back to `autoGeneratedId`. When both are placeholders/missing, the holder genuinely has no barcode configured.
